extra.reason: Implemented tygo-based TypeScript protocol generation, preserved the $lib/types wrapper, and verified Go and web checks.
Fixed fake-agent pending approval collisions by deriving request IDs from the session ID, and added regression coverage for two fake sessions on one store.

Composer on the session detail page: sendInput command (valibot {id,text}) POSTs hub /sessions/{id}/input; sent text renders via the live stream as input_received (no optimistic insert). Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, disabled while empty/pending, inline errors (e.g. 409 'session is not active'), composer hidden when session finished. Passing check/lint; live verification pending a running hostd/agent.
Implemented web approval cards with approve, deny, and inline reply actions; verified with lint and type checks.
Implemented hub-only Go-code-first OpenAPI generation with a typed web SDK wrapper, preserving existing hub behavior and adding generation/check scripts.

Scaffolded Expo SDK 56 app under mobile/ (create-expo-app default template), stripped to a barebones expo-router skeleton: minimal Stack layout + single home screen, removed example screens/components/hooks/theme/assets and example-only deps. Added mobile/CLAUDE.md (stack + conventions) with AGENTS.md symlink. Commits 40f93ab, 1d4d99c.
Implemented solo auth: web is gated by Cloudflare Access, and the deployed hub/web/hostd/CLI path uses shared bearer-token auth via environment/secrets.
CLI now takes --hub-url (full URL, HTTPS-capable) instead of --addr, matching tethon-hostd

hostd now defaults -db to a stable per-user app-data path (macOS ~/Library/Application Support/tethon, Linux $XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share/tethon); -db stays an explicit override, worktree/cache roots derive from the resolved db dir, needed dirs are created, and resolved db/worktree/cache paths are logged on startup.
Implemented macOS LaunchAgent install/run story for tethon-hostd, documented setup and smoke tests, and verified Go checks.
Implemented bounded host-to-hub requests plus retry/backoff for registration and heartbeat, including re-registration when the hub forgets the host.
Documented the current runnable end-to-end path from hub and macOS host install to first remote claude-cli session, including web operation, CLI fallback, and troubleshooting.
Implemented no-downtime solo token rotation: hub accepts primary plus additional bearer tokens, Dokploy passes rotation tokens, and docs cover rotating web, hostd, and CLI secrets.
Implemented structured hostd/hub logs, surfaced hub load errors in web, documented log locations and offline causes, and verified control/web checks.
